children: FORT WORTH, Texas, Sept. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --
AZZ Inc.

), the leading independent provider of hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating solutions in North America, today announced its participation in the following investor conferences and non-deal roadshows during the month of September:

The Jefferies 2026 Global Industrials Conference on September 9–10, 2026, at the Westin Times Square in New York City. David Nark, Chief Marketing, Communications, and Investor Relations Officer of AZZ will host one-on-one investor meetings on Thursday, September 10, 2026. Investors interested in meeting with the Company should contact the Jefferies Conference Team at

The Thompson Davis & Co. non-deal roadshow on September 17, 2026, in New York City. During the event, Jason Crawford, Chief Financial Officer and David Nark, Chief Marketing, Communications, and Investor Relations Officer of AZZ will meet with institutional investors to discuss the Company's recent operational highlights, strategic growth initiatives, and upcoming milestones. Investors interested in meeting with the Company should contact Adam Thalhimer at

The Sidoti Small Cap Virtual Conference, on September 23-24, 2026. David Nark, Chief Marketing, Communications, and Investor Relations Officer of AZZ, will present on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, at 11:30-12:00 pm Eastern, and will host one-on-one investor meetings. A webcast of the presentation will be available on the Company's investor relations website at
. Investors interested in meeting with the Company should contact the Sidoti Marketing and Events Team at
AZZ Inc.

Founded in 1956, AZZ Inc. is the leading independent provider of hot-dip galvanizing and coil coating solutions to a broad range of end-markets. Collectively, our business segments provide sustainable, unmatched metal coating solutions that enhance the longevity and appearance of buildings, products and infrastructure that are essential to everyday life.
